summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the de facto standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data, and services, with 2026 seeing a decisive shift toward remote, OAuth-secured hosted endpoints from major vendors like GitHub, Vercel, Linear, Notion, Supabase, and Stripe. The ecosystem now spans aggregator marketplaces, security gateways, and thousands of individual servers, letting any MCP-compatible client (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, custom agents) tap into a shared, composable tool layer. This matters because MCP turns isolated LLMs into action-capable agents that can read repos, browse the web, query databases, and automate workflows through a single standard protocol.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (Composio, Smithery, mcp.so) are marketplaces/platforms that bundle and host many servers behind one integration, gateways/proxies (Cloudflare, Kong, agentgateway) sit in front of servers to add auth, routing, and security, while individual servers (Playwright, GitHub, Filesystem) each expose one specific tool or data source.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search, and repo automation
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; usage governed by GitHub subscription tiers (Team/Enterprise)
strengths: Deep repo, issue, and PR automation
First-class support in Cursor, Copilot, and Claude Desktop
tools.best_for: Automating repository workflows and code operations from AI agents

tools.name: Playwright MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Browser automation, web navigation, scraping, and end-to-end testing
strengths: Reliable deterministic web automation for agents
Top recommendation for Cursor web tasks
tools.best_for: Giving agents robust browser control for testing and web interaction

tools.name: Filesystem MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Local file system read/write, directory listing, and file search
strengths: Reference implementation maintained by the MCP team
Essential for local coding workflows in Cursor/Claude
tools.best_for: Local file access for coding assistants and desktop agents

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ apps including GitHub, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Linear, Jira through managed auth
tools.pricing_paid: Paid tiers start around $29/mo with usage-based scaling for teams
strengths: Managed authentication across hundreds of integrations
tools.best_for: Rapidly giving agents access to many SaaS tools without managing auth

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP Server / Remote MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosting and securing remote MCP servers with OAuth, Workers, and edge deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plan from $5/mo plus usage-based pricing
strengths: Easy remote MCP deployment on edge Workers
tools.best_for: Deploying and securing remote MCP servers at scale

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, auth, storage, and project management on Supabase
tools.pricing_paid: Supabase Pro from $25/mo; MCP access included with projects
strengths: Direct database querying and schema management for agents
tools.best_for: Letting agents query and manage Postgres/Supabase backends

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Registry of thousands of MCP servers with one-click install and hosting
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based hosting tiers for deployed servers
tools.best_for: Discovering and installing MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and workspace content read/write
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Notion plans; paid Notion tiers from $10/user/mo
strengths: Knowledge base and docs access for agents
tools.best_for: Agents reading and updating team docs and knowledge bases

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: Community-curated directory of MCP servers and clients for discovery
strengths: High search visibility for MCP discovery
tools.best_for: Browsing and comparing available MCP servers

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Stripe payments, customers, invoices, and subscription management
tools.pricing_paid: No MCP fee; standard Stripe transaction fees apply
tools.best_for: Automating payment and billing workflows via agents

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, components, and design-to-code context
tools.pricing_paid: Requires paid Figma seats (from $12/editor/mo) for full access
strengths: Official hosted endpoint for design context
tools.best_for: Design-to-code generation and pulling design context into agents

tools.name: Docker MCP Toolkit / Catalog
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers with secure isolated runtime and a curated catalog
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Pro/Team from $9/user/mo for advanced features
strengths: Secure sandboxed execution of MCP servers
Curated MCP catalog in Docker Desktop
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely in isolated containers

tools.name: Slack MCP Server (korotovsky)
tools.connects_to: Slack messages, channels, and workspace interaction without admin approval
strengths: Most widely adopted Slack MCP (~1,800 GitHub stars)
tools.best_for: Agents reading and posting to Slack workspaces
